case_name: M P Lakshmanan vs Smt S Laxmi
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed petition under Section 11 of Hindu Marriage Act to dissolve marriage. Respondent was his oil mill worker who represented herself as an orphan and was nominated as nominee for family pension.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that the marriage was not dissolved according to law.
legal_principles.held: According to him, both Venkateshgowda and a person of Palayad are alive and her marriage has not been dissolved according to law.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is considered valid if it has not been dissolved according to law.
legal_principles.held: The respondent taking advantage of the petitioner's sympathy and oscillating mind on account of loss of company and loneliness, tried to harass the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment is set aside and the petition under Section 11 of Hindu Marriage Act is allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
